Name: BEHAVIOR_PARAM_ST
Description: Determines the behavior parameters used when triggering projectiles and attacks.

Fields.Name: Behavior Variation ID
Fields.Description: Part of the ID the game builds to find this move's attack data. The game never reads it alone.

Fields.Name: Behavior Judgement ID
Fields.Description: Must match the judgement ID in this move's animation file. Part of the ID the game builds to find attack data.

Fields.Name: ID Calculation Rule
Fields.Description: Unknown. An old rule for building attack IDs. Its effect is not documented.

Fields.Name: Call ID Type
Fields.Description: Which kind of data this move runs. Must match the Call ID below.

Fields.Name: Call ID
Fields.Description: The move data this behavior runs. Call ID Type above sets its list.

Fields.Name: Particle Variation ID
Fields.Description: Shifts which visual effect plays with this move. 0 probably plays the effect the animation names.

Fields.Name: Action Cost: Stamina
Fields.Description: Stamina this move costs. 0 makes it free.

Fields.Name: Action Cost: MP
Fields.Description: MP this move costs. The game has no MP pool, so this does nothing.

Fields.Name: Action Category
Fields.Description: Which buffs can strengthen this move. None means no buff targets it.

Fields.Name: Action Cost: Humanity
Fields.Description: Humanity this move costs. 0 makes it free.
